Your child spends hours every day in a building you never walk into. 🏫 How is she really treated in there?

Iris is at school all day, and the doors close behind her. So in a calm moment at bedtime, her mom asks her four questions: 🌙
1️⃣ Who did you sit with at lunch and break? Let her tell it.
2️⃣ What was the best part of today, and the hardest? Don't rush to fix it.
3️⃣ What happens when someone messes up in class? Iris goes quiet. That question opened a door. 🚪
4️⃣ Which grown-up would you go to for help? Iris shrugs.

Why it matters: in one US school crime survey, about 2 out of 3 students who were bullied never told an adult. 💔

So they pick one together: Mrs. Lane, the librarian. 📚 One hard day isn't the whole story. But when it keeps happening, talk with the school. Iris's mom did.

No room is dark to God. He sees every classroom. 🙏 Jesus was laughed at too, so no child ever has to face it alone.

Weeks later, the question on the board is 7 × 8. Iris gets it wrong… and nobody laughs. She puts her hand up again anyway. ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
